office: Yemen's General Consulate in Frankfurt, through the embassies in Europe, after approval from Yemen's main issuance center

routes.label: through an embassy in Europe, processed in Frankfurt: 30 to 90 days

note: The Frankfurt consulate's fees for a first passport as the embassy in Warsaw lists them: 57 euros up to 8 years, 87 from 9 to 18, 117 above 18 (read as from 19), 42 for students (not modelled); the embassy in The Hague says applications go to Frankfurt and take 30 to 90 days, after approval from Yemen's main issuance center. The fee in Yemen and validity aren't read.

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Yemen in The Hague, Passports Issuance
sources.said: All completed passport applications from The Hague are sent to the General Consulate in Frankfurt for processing. Passports are issued only after approval from Yemen's main issuance center. The consulate is not responsible for delays due to incomplete applications. Processing takes 30 to 90 days
